natural_body: 40% SMB discount: signup +31%, revenue +18%, but retention -12%; no renewal.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two prior records indicate that simplifying onboarding/registration improved completion, time-to-value, and early activation. Promotional pricing directly addresses competitive pressure but has documented retention harm and no renewal, making it unsuitable for the sustainable-revenue objective. Verify the onboarding evidence before committing the week’s slot.
